Shannon McRandle as Mara Jade on the cover of ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000). First official flesh-and-blood image of Mara Jade, photographed for Decipher's Star Wars Customizable Card Game. Photograph: Mark Atkinson, Otto Studios. Used on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]] and [[Shannon Baksa]].

Fair use of a magazine cover for identification of the SWCCG model and the magazine feature.
